zh.title: 多邊形裁切探索器
zh.subtitle: 保留每個頂點的順序。看清畫面、精確面積與 CSS 之間的差別。
zh.dimensionHint: 40–800 的整數；不含正負號或前導零。
zh.coordinateHint: x 向右、y 向下；0–100%，最多兩位小數。保留原始文字，不自動排序或修復。
zh.rows: 有序頂點（選取一列以新增或移除）
zh.limit: 頂點數限制：3–12。新增的空欄位必須填好。
zh.initial: 編輯頂點後按「產生」。目前沒有結果。
zh.dirty: 輸入已改變；請重新產生。舊結果已清除。
zh.generated: 已產生同一份完整結果。
zh.error: 請修正標示的欄位或頂點。
zh.SCHEMA: 資料結構不符；請重設後重試。
zh.LENGTH: 原始文字最多 32 字元。
zh.GRAMMAR: 只接受指定 ASCII 數字格式，不接受符號、指數或前導零。
zh.ZERO_AREA: 有向面積為零；不輸出幾何結論。
zh.INTERNAL: 無法產生安全結果；請重設。
zh.unsupported: 瀏覽器不支援必要裁切能力；不顯示未裁切的成功結果。
zh.schematic: 02 / 完整示意圖（非實際像素大小）
zh.native: 03 / 原生 CSS 裁切（實際尺寸，可局部捲動）
zh.selected: 已選取 CSS；請自行使用鍵盤或選單複製。
zh.selectionFail: 無法自動選取；請在唯讀文字框手動選取。
zh.signed: 整數 q 單位的有向二倍面積 S
zh.helpTitle: 畫面裁切，不是改變布局盒
zh.help: 百分比依零邊框、零內距的 border-box 計算；最後一點自動連回第一點。允許簡單凹形與直線上的冗餘點，但本工具拒絕重點、重疊、接觸、相交及零面積；這不是完整 CSS 語法限制。先套用凹 L 形，修改頂點製造相交，再依邊標號修復。改變寬高會改像素與面積，但不改百分比 CSS。
zh.help2: 示意圖標出 P 頂點和 E 邊；原生預覽只顯示圖樣被裁切的畫面。外框仍保留完整布局尺寸。表格精確分數是權威值；約 0.000 不代表精確面積為零。輸出是單一 CSS 宣告，不含尺寸或圖樣；套用到不同邊框、內距或內容時須自行確認情境。
zh.privacy: 只用合成數字，資料留在記憶體；無上傳、儲存、URL 狀態或剪貼簿 API。單行輸入可能移除 CR/LF；切換語言保留原始文字。重新載入回預設，快取返回清除舊結果。

en.title: Polygon Clip Explorer
en.subtitle: Keep every vertex in order. Understand painted shape, exact area and CSS together.
en.setup: 01 / Edit the reference box and vertices
en.dimensionHint: Integer 40–800; no signs or leading zeros.
en.coordinateHint: x grows right, y down; 0–100%, at most two decimals. Raw text stays intact; no automatic sorting or repair.
en.rows: Ordered vertices (select a row to add or remove)
en.limit: Vertex limit: 3–12. Fill both empty coordinates after adding.
en.initial: Edit vertices, then Generate. No result yet.
en.dirty: Inputs changed. Generate again; old results are cleared.
en.error: Correct the marked fields or vertices.
en.SCHEMA: Invalid data structure; reset and retry.
en.LENGTH: Raw text is limited to 32 characters.
en.GRAMMAR: Use the specified ASCII numeric grammar; no signs, exponent or leading zeros.
en.RANGE: Number is outside this field's range.
en.ZERO_AREA: Signed area is zero; no geometric result is published.
en.INTERNAL: Could not produce a safe result; reset.
en.unsupported: Required clipping capability is unavailable; an unclipped face is not a successful result.
en.native: 03 / Native CSS clip (actual size, locally scrollable)
en.selected: CSS selected; use your own keyboard or menu to copy.
en.selectionFail: Automatic selection failed; select manually in the read-only field.
en.signed: Signed twice-area S in integer q units
en.helpTitle: Clipping changes paint, not the layout box
en.help: Percentages use a border-box with zero border and padding; the last vertex closes to the first. Simple concave rings and straight-through redundant points are allowed. This tool rejects duplicates, overlap, touch, crossings and zero area; these are not all CSS grammar restrictions. Apply Concave L, introduce a crossing, then repair it using the reported edge labels. Changing dimensions changes pixels and area, not percentage CSS.
en.help2: The schematic labels P vertices and E edges; the native preview shows only clipped pattern paint. The outside outline retains the full layout size. Exact table fractions are authoritative: approx. 0.000 does not mean exact zero area. Output is one CSS declaration, without dimensions or pattern; check context when adopting other borders, padding or content.
en.privacy: Synthetic numbers stay in memory: no uploads, storage, URL state or Clipboard API. Single-line inputs may strip CR/LF; language switching retains raw text. Reload restores defaults; BFCache return clears old results.
